events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable showman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life' – The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: John Lennon: 46 years since his passing
events.blurb: Music legend John Lennon was tragically shot and killed in New York on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering a true visionary, John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The incomparable David Bowie was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Bowie
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and legacy of a true musical chameleon and cultural icon, David Bowie, who would have been 80 today.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Elvis
angles.copy: Long live the King! Remembering the legend who changed music forever on what would have been his 92nd birthday.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Happy 83rd to the guitar god, Jimmy Page, who wrote the rulebook for rock riffs.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic singer Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Raise a glass to the rock and roll legend with the unmistakable voice on his 82nd birthday.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: Happy 66th to the man who made 'Our House' a national treasure. #Suggs

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Young
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the voice behind some of the greatest 80s anthems, Paul Young.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dolly Parton
angles.copy: Happy 81st to the legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, still working 9 to 5 and beyond.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gary Barlow
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th to the man who's penned countless pop anthems, Gary Barlow.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British soul singer Billy Ocean, known for hits like 'Caribbean Queen', celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Billy Ocean
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car... and wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th!

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame: 38 years since first induction
events.blurb: The very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989, honouring legends like The Beatles and Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Hall of Fame Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock royalty got their official crowns at the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who's your all-time Hall of Famer?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mark Owen
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th to the charming Take That star, Mark Owen.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic Rooftop Concert: 58 years on
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Concert Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since the Fab Four took to the roof for one last, unforgettable show.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Phil Collins
angles.copy: Happy 76th to the drumming maestro and hitmaker, Phil Collins. You can feel it coming in the air tonight.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67

angles.name: Happy Birthday Hugh Grant
angles.copy: Happy 67th to the king of charming awkwardness, Hugh Grant. Which of his films is your favourite?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46

angles.name: Happy Birthday David Jason

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 years on

angles.name: Remembering The Day The Music Died
angles.copy: Remembering the immense talent lost 68 years ago on "The Day The Music Died." Their legacy lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rick Astley

events.title: Whitney Houston: 15 years since her passing

angles.name: Tribute to Whitney Houston

events.title: Take That's original split: 31 years on

angles.name: Take That Split Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-one years ago, the world almost ended for pop fans when Take That split. Thankfully, they came back stronger!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
